Ptrs04E577.name: Overworld event: state machine and tiles
summary: Second half of the overworld event handler that CODE_04E570 enters through ExecutePtr with state [$1B86] (8 states).
Runs when the player beats a level that triggers an overworld event ([$1DE9] set, event number [$1DEA]): smoke puff, new level tile,
event path tiles in the layer 2 map, then a final step that applies direct map edits and records the event in [$1F02].
Contains the pointer table, small tables, state 0-4 code and the stripe image builders for 2x2 and 6x6 tile blocks.

s04E8E4.name: Table: event numbers for map edits
summary: 44 entries; each is matched against [$1DEA] by CODE_04E9EC.

s04E9EC.name: Overworld event: apply edits, fade tiles
summary: State 7 (CODE_04E9EC): applies every matching map edit from the four tables, then ends the event: [$1B86] = 0, [$13D9]++, marks
$04EA62: builds the palette upload buffer at $0907. $04EAA4: state 4, fades the event tile in as 36 OAM sprites until timer [$1495] reaches $40,
then draws the layer 2 tile and moves to the next one.

s04EBEB.name: Overworld event: smoke puff, level tile
summary: States 1 and 6: animate a four-sprite smoke puff at ([$1B82],[$1B83]) while timer [$1B84] counts down. State 1 uses DATA_04EBE1 tiles,
state 6 uses DATA_04EBDA. At timer $10 (state 6) the level tile is replaced; at $18 (state 1) CODE_04EEAA runs.
$04EC67: converts effect position to screen position ([$00],[$01]). $04EC78: state 5, checks the level tile at the event position and starts the reveal.

s04ECD3.name: Table: level tile 2x2 graphics
summary: 22 entries of 8 bytes: four tilemap words (tile, properties). Probably indexed like DATA_04DA1D by CODE_04ED83.
